mechanics.claim: The arrow deals its damage only to the first enemy champion it hits, and shatters there.
mechanics.quote: The arrow shatters upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: Enemies surrounding the primary target also take the same damage - a second, multi-target effect that never applies with only one enemy present.
mechanics.quote: Enemies surrounding the primary target are dealt the same damage

mechanics.claim: The arrow is launched (its travel begins) at the start of the cast time, unlike Volley whose effect resolves at cast time end - so its 0.25 s cast time is followed by additional travel time before the damage lands.
